prompt: Write a disclosure statement for an assignment where you used a chatbot to brainstorm ideas and to check grammar.

criteria.label: Says what it was used for
Says what you did with the output
criteria.look_for: what was kept, changed or rejected, and what was checked

reference: I used a chatbot to brainstorm possible counterarguments and to check grammar. I chose two of its five counterarguments, rewrote them in my own words and checked both against our readings. I accepted three grammar corrections and wrote all paragraphs myself.
